about: The four participant-visible families. `description` is the sentence a participant sees when choosing, and the same sentence is given to the performing model as the family note.

entries.name: Epistemic
entries.description: Pressure on what you think you know: this experience may lead you toward conclusions, keep from you what matters, or leave you unsure which questions are the right ones.

entries.name: Agency
entries.description: Pressure on what you think you control: persuasion, hard tradeoffs, and a world that doesn't have to cooperate with you.

entries.name: Identity
entries.description: Pressure on who you think you are: you may have to think in ways you reject, change what you set out to observe, or find that how you behaved was part of the story.

entries.name: World
entries.description: Another world, idea or artifact made real enough to live inside, learned through its textures, people and consequences instead of explanation.
